description:
Get account settings: the outbound webhook endpoint with its event subscriptions, and the default proof lifetime. Branding (name, logo, colour, email theme, support email) belongs to each sub-account: read it with get_sub_account. The webhook signing secret is NOT returned to an API key — the response reports webhook.secret_set instead, and the value is shown only when it is made: in the update_settings response that created or rotated it, or to the owner rotating it on the Webhooks page in the dashboard (https://proof.holdings/webhooks).

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.
name: get_settings

proof_expiry_days.description: Default lifetime in days of newly issued verification proofs, or null when the account has never set one. Confirmation-decision proofs do not use it.

webhook.description: Outbound webhook configuration — DEPRECATED (#421). An account switched over to webhook endpoints sees its account-wide (`legacy`) endpoint here: `url` is null while that endpoint is disabled, a `url` write updates or creates it, `url: null` disables it (its secret is kept), and `rotate_secret` rotates its secret. An account not yet switched over sees its settings fields, as before. Omitted for an API key bound to one sub-account.
